name: application-map-listing-split
title: Map Listing Split
description: A scrollable listing list paired with a map pane, where a listing's highlighted state syncs with its numbered pin on the map.
useWhen: Browsing geographically-anchored listings (rentals, stores, events) where seeing location alongside details helps users choose.
Hovering or selecting a list item should highlight its corresponding map pin, and vice versa, to reinforce the location-to-listing relationship.
avoidWhen: The listings have no meaningful location — a plain list or grid is simpler without the map pane.
You need a generic two-pane layout unrelated to geography — use `Split Pane Diff` or a plain layout grid instead.
responsiveBehavior: The listing list keeps a fixed width beside a flex-1 map pane; on narrow viewports, stack the list above the map or make the map a toggleable full-screen view instead of shrinking both panes.
accessibility: Each listing and its map pin share the same visible number, so the correspondence between panes doesn't rely on hover/color alone.
The highlighted listing uses both a background tint and a ring border, and its pin uses both a larger size and a ring glow, so the highlight is legible without relying on a single visual cue.
Listing price, bed/bath count, and name are all rendered as text, keeping the essential information available even without the map.

variants.title: Rental listings
variants.description: Four rental listings in a scrollable left panel beside a map pane with numbered pins; listing #2 ('Harbor View') is shown highlighted in sync with its enlarged, ring-glowing map pin.
accessibility: Each listing card and its map pin share the same number, giving a non-color-dependent correspondence.

variants.title: Rental listings (Dark)
variants.description: Map listing split adapted for dark surfaces, including the map grid pattern and pin colors.
accessibility: Listing text, pin numbers, and the highlight ring all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark panes.
